notes: Pure hardware paper: no dataset, no accuracy, no training; the record correctly has no datasets, so usages is empty. All 30 record values match Table I (p. 4). Table I area columns have no unit in the paper. The 'Avg. Inferences (Millions s^-1)' column is recorded as 'average throughput'. The datapath size is not stated: the population count is eight-input (Sec. IV-B), which would allow up to 8 votes per polarity, but the number of clauses and features is never given, so n_clauses is not_reported. Text says dual-rail average throughput is worsened, which holds for UMC LL (300 vs 480) but not for FULL DIFFUSION (510 vs 410) in Table I - an inconsistency in the paper, not in the record. The record's split='test' on these hardware rows is not meaningful (no data split exists). Fig. 3 latency-vs-voltage curve not extractable as text. Datapath is a single-class (binary) TM classifier; T/s/epochs/TA states are null because the inference-only circuit takes TA exclude actions as primary inputs.
